name: letter-pullup
title: Letter Pullup
description: Each character of a string rises up into position in sequence, starting transparent and low, so a headline assembles itself letter by letter.
use: A hero headline should arrive with a bit of character instead of a plain fade.
avoid: It animates only on mount, so a headline far down the page plays before anyone sees it.
a11y: Each letter is its own h1 element, so screen readers may read the headline letter by letter; reduced-motion is ignored. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two lines of very large sans-serif text sit centred on black: Launch day in white and is finally here in blue. A small Replay button rests in the lower right.
behaves: On mount every letter starts below and invisible, then springs up into line with a small stagger from left to right. Replay restarts the whole sequence.
customise: words, delay and className are props; the pull-up distance, font and drop shadow are fixed in the source.
weight: light: One motion element per letter, animating once on mount.
